ayahOccurrences.text: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ

ayahOccurrences.text: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine singular imperfect verb, subjunctive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَعْرَىٰ is in the derivative form: تَعْرَى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ر/ي ʿ–r–y remote open expanse of land, treeless area; nakedness, to be naked, to become emaciated, to strip off, to strip meat off bones; to evacuate. A degree of overlapping between this root and root ع/ر/و ʿ–r–w exists, as might be expected of corresponding ي and و radicals.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 3 times in the Qur’an:
تَعْرَى taʿrā 1 time and عَرَاءٌ ʿarāʾ 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَعْرَى taʿrā [imperf. of v. عَرِيَ ʿariya, intrans.] to be or become naked

(20:118) إِنَّ‏ ‏لَكَ‏ ‏أَلاَّ‏ ‏تَجُوعَ‏ ‏فِيهَا‏ ‏وَلاَ‏ ‏تَعْرَى‏ it is [granted] for you that you will neither go hungry, nor naked in it [the Garden].

entries.label: عَرَاءٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَرَاءٌ ʿarāʾ [n] wide and open, barren, treeless land

(37:145) فَنَبَذْنَاهُ‏ ‏بِالْعَرَاءِ‏ ‏وَهُوَ‏ ‏سَقِيمٌ‏ so We cast him out, ailing and thin, onto a barren, open shore.
